data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure: open Experience, click Baggage allowance, then pick the cabin class, with cabin_class as the parameter. It adds an "open site" step and a "read table" step, and it describes the cabin class as a tab where the true action was a link. Its examples list only Economy, Business and First, so it is slightly vague, but a browser automation could still be built from it.
